body.name: Three-facet endpoint certificates
body.construction: Write each \(h_i\in\mathcal H_L\) as \(a_i(p)+\beta_i^\top\theta\ge0\). For \(d\in\mathcal D\), \(\mathcal D_d^-\) contains every nonnegative vector \(\lambda\) supported on at most three linearly independent \(\beta_i\) with \(\sum_i\lambda_i\beta_i=e_d\), and \(\mathcal D_d^+\) contains every nonnegative vector \(\mu\) supported on at most three linearly independent \(\beta_i\) with \(\sum_i\mu_i\beta_i=-e_d\).
